sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
def Npos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='N':
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs))
def bluepos(f):
    for n in f.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color']=='b' and n['pixels']>=16:
            rs=[p[0] for p in n['boundary']]; cs=[p[1] for p in n['boundary']]
            return (min(rs),min(cs),max(rs),max(cs))
def over(): return bool(last_action_result.get('game_over'))
def win(): return bool(last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'))
print("before blue",bluepos(current_frame),"player",Npos(current_frame))
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':36,'col':48}])
print("after blue",bluepos(current_frame),"player",Npos(current_frame))
for d in ['UP','UP','UP']:
    p0=Npos(current_frame)
    action([d]); p1=Npos(current_frame)
    print(d,p0,"->",p1,"over?",over(),"win?",win())
    if over() or win(): break
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
